channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Who is L Murugan? From son of daily-wage labourers to MoS, why his resignation fuels cabinet reshuffle buzz
item.description: Murugan said that from being the son of daily wage labourers to serving in the Union Council of Ministers under the leadership of PM Modi has been the greatest privilege of his life.

item.title: US federal judge allows news organisations access to White House, blocks Trump's ruling in another setback
item.description: US federal judge Timothy Kelly ordered the White House to restore access for 78 reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico, saying Trump’s ban may have broken the law. The outlets welcomed the ruling, which comes weeks before the US midterm elections.

item.title: Ilhan Omar’s immigration records under scrutiny amid Trump's fraud claims, $30 million net worth controversy
item.description: Federal agents searched Ilhan Omar’s Washington home over allegations of false statements in immigration records and subpoenaed relatives. Omar denied wrongdoing and called the search political intimidation, while Trump attacked her over her finances and immigration history.

item.title: CJP Protest: Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das sent to 5-day judicial custody; Abhijeet Dipke dares PM to ‘shows some guts’
item.description: CJP Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were sent to a five-day judicial custody on Wednesday.

item.title: Want to study in UK? ‘Universities revoke offers, 10% of study visa refused’ — what India students should know
item.description: While visa applications can be withdrawn for other reasons, universities were quoted as saying that the main driver had been an increase in the number of offers they revoked, a report claimed.

item.title: ‘Brutal’, ‘awkward’: How White House officials criticise Katie Zacharia’s 14-minute debut as press secretary
item.description: White House advisers and officials shared negative reviews of her debut appearance with CNN. One characterising it as ‘brutal.’ Others that CNN spoke with described her performance as ‘unusual’, ‘awkward’, ‘stilted’ and, at times, ‘uncomfortable.’

item.title: New York City's historic horse carriage rides to come to an end soon? All about Mayor Zohran Mamdani's latest move
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and City Council Speaker Julie Menin have reached an agreement to ban horse-drawn carriage rides in Central Park, ending a practice that has operated for more than 150 years.

item.title: Fuel prices today: Check petrol, diesel and CNG rates on 14 October in different cities across India
item.description: Fuel prices varied across the cities surveyed: Hyderabad had the highest petrol price, Thiruvananthapuram the highest diesel price and Chandigarh the lowest for both.&nbsp;

item.title: Aramco Headquarters Hit as Houthi Missiles Strike Saudi Arabia
item.description: Saudi Aramco’s executive headquarters in eastern Saudi Arabia was hit during a missile attack by Yemen’s Houthi militants on Tuesday, causing a fire in a part of the complex, the kingdom’s energy ministry said.

item.title: Who is Abdulrahman Alfozan? OpenAI engineer arrested by FBI for planting recording device in conference room
item.description: OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan was arrested after a hidden, encrypted recording device was found in an executive conference room at the company’s San Francisco office. The DOJ said he was not authorised to access the room.

item.title: CJP lawyer says Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka, and Ajinkya Shinde 'arrested', calls it 'illegal' | What we know so far
item.description: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde were detained, and a case was registered by Delhi Police while attempting to enter Jantar Mantar, a day after authorities de-notified the site as a designated protest location.

item.title: NASA gives you chance to win $150,000: What is ‘Lunar Grounding Challenge’ and how can you participate?
item.description: NASA is offering up to $150,000 in prizes to whoever wins the 'Lunar Grounding Challenge.'

item.title: Russia Arrests Japanese Reporter for Espionage as Spat Grows
item.description: Russian authorities said they’d detained a Japanese journalist on suspicion of espionage, with a court ruling that he be held in custody for two months, the Federal Security Service (FSB) said in a statement on website.

item.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery, Vatican confirms
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican confirmed. The 71-year-old pontiff is recovering in hospital, while further tests will determine the next steps in his treatment.

item.title: TMC alleges woman tried to attack Mamata Banerjee with knife in West Bengal, files police complaint
item.description: According to the official complaint lodged by the party, the confrontation unfolded after an intoxicated intruder managed to breach the perimeter gates of the high-security zone.

item.title: Unpaid salaries, grounded planes: SpiceJet faces fresh operational challenges
item.description: Recently, 40 pilots of SpiceJet's Q400 aircraft fleet refused to fly over unpaid dues amid new operational challenges. The budget airline had 10 operational aircraft while 37 aircraft remained parked, added Planespotters.net.

item.title: Strong statistical framework key to achieving Viksit Bharat goal by 2047: PM's Principal Secretary PK Mishra
item.description: PK Mishra stated statistics, data, technology, planning and governance are increasingly interconnected elements of India's development journey. A robust statistical system, he said, must enable governments to measure development progress across states and districts.

item.title: ‘Agreed to build on positive momentum’: PM Modi speaks with Canada’s Carney ahead of FM Anita Anand’s India visit
item.description: PM Narendra Modi spoke with Canadian PM Mark Carney, agreeing to build on positive momentum in bilateral ties and pursue cooperation in trade, energy, technology and security. The call came ahead of Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand’s India visit, as both sides advance CEPA negotiations.

item.title: US midterms 2026: Why Indian-American voters’ political influence faces a key test amid Trump’s immigration crackdown
item.description: Indian-American voters’ political influence faces a key test in the 2026 US midterms amid Trump’s immigration crackdown. While surveys show a Democratic preference, shifting party loyalties, high voter turnout and campaign donations could shape closely contested races.

item.title: India-US trade talks heading in right direction, Jaishankar says as both sides work to finalise a deal
item.description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar says India-US trade negotiations are moving in the right direction, with a deal being worked out. However, changing US tariff policies and unresolved trade issues continue to complicate the agreement’s finalisation.

item.title: Tamil Nadu influencer gets TV worth ₹1.69 lakh, fridge as ‘Diwali gifts’; but he says ‘stop placing orders’ - here’s why
item.description: Delivery workers from Amazon and Flipkart began arriving with refrigerators, washing machines, smartphones, and televisions.

item.title: Bihar boat tragedy: 11 killed, 20 missing as boat capsizes in Ganga in Bihar’s Vaishali district
item.description: Reportedly, 25 to 30 people were on a medium-sized boat and mostly travelling to attend a feast when the incident took place on Tuesday evening. Search operations have been launched by authorities.

item.title: India issues fresh advisory for citizens in Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks: Stay indoors, don’t share videos
item.description: India has urged its nationals in Saudi Arabia to remain calm and vigilant after an attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport killed an Indian citizen. Four injured Indians remain in intensive care, while flight suspensions and airport disruptions continue amid regional tensions.

item.title: Chennai bound IndiGo flight diverted to Hyderabad after ablaze onboard: How power banks catch fire on plane?
item.description: IndiGo flight 6E 6115 from Delhi to Chennai was diverted to Hyderabad following 'smoke' onboard, the company said. Here's why a power bank can pose risk in an aircraft.

item.title: Sebi proposes stricter IPO funds tracking, fines for non-cooperation
item.description: The regulator’s consultation paper suggests allowing monitoring agencies to report directly to exchanges and penalizing uncooperative issuers with a ₹50,000 fine and frozen demat accounts.

item.title: UPI fee set to raise costs for some merchants as industry awaits rollout
item.description: A merchant survey included in How Urban India Pays 2026, a report by Pahlé India Foundation in partnership with Amazon Pay, found that 25% of respondents expect to pay more than ₹5,000 a month. Another 58% of the merchants expect to pay ₹1,000 or less, including 13% who expect no charge.

item.title: Liver cancer awareness month: 5 lesser-known habits that may increase risk, doctor explains
item.description: Liver cancer risk extends beyond alcohol consumption. Doctors highlight five overlooked factors, including missed hepatitis tests, skipping hepatitis B vaccination, uncontrolled weight and diabetes, regular alcohol intake and untreated liver disease, that can damage liver health.

item.title: Adani's Mumbai airport puts Navi Mumbai flight shift on hold after airline pushback
item.description: The proposed shift of 265 weekly international departures from Adani's Mumbai Airport to Navi Mumbai International Airport has been deferred until the summer schedule beginning in March 2027 following airline objections.&nbsp;

item.title: US-based grocery chain Kroger to cut 3,000 corporate jobs over three years amid AI expansion
item.description: Kroger plans to eliminate 3,000 corporate jobs over three years as it expands artificial intelligence and streamlines operations. The US supermarket chain says the restructuring will reduce duplicated work and free up resources for stores and customers.

item.title: Earth Infrastructure case: ED's ₹140 crore attachment and ₹2,004 crore fraud allegations explained
item.description: The ED's Delhi Zonal Office-II has attached immovable properties linked to the company and its promoters, including Avdhesh Kumar Goel, Rajnish Mittal, Atul Gupta and Vikas Gupta, among others.

item.title: ‘You terrorist’: Bangladesh’s Muhammad Yunus heckled at New York airport — Why expatriates are angry | Watch
item.description: Bangladesh’s former interim leader Muhammad Yunus was heckled by Bangladeshi expatriates at New York’s JFK airport, where protesters accused him of killings and undermining democracy.&nbsp;

item.title: Why was Canadian actor William Shatner’s kidney stone auctioned for ₹71.30 lakh?
item.description: He added that the unusual item was eventually sold at auction for $75,000 (approximately ₹71.30 lakh)

item.title: Rahul Gandhi vows to fight ‘to the end’ to restore democracy, targets Modi government over electoral integrity
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has vowed to continue the opposition’s fight to restore democracy, accusing the Modi government of undermining constitutional values and electoral integrity. He also challenged restrictions on protests at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar.

item.title: Bangladesh Home Minister skips first BIMSTEC meet in Delhi: What it means for India ties
item.description: Bangladesh Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed will skip the first BIMSTEC home ministers’ meeting in New Delhi, with Dhaka sending a senior officials’ delegation instead. The absence comes amid strained India-Bangladesh ties over Sheikh Hasina’s presence in India and other bilateral issues.

item.title: India’s long-term bond yields less sensitive to inflation in AI era: NIPFP
item.description: An NIPFP study reveals that since late 2022, India's long-term bond yields have become far less sensitive to inflation and money supply growth, while short-term rates have become more responsive.&nbsp;
